redFirst.basis: `node --test tests/prescan-python.test.mjs tests/merge.test.mjs tests/prescan-node-backend.test.mjs` in a throwaway tree at HEAD exited 1, but its output carries no test tally this command reads, so an assertion failure cannot be told from a crash - no test is known to have been collected: no tally or error reader matched its output, so no line of it is quoted as decisive; run without CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, OLDPWD; no ignored dependency directory linked from the project root; the user's .npmrc in the home directory dropped (every run has a fresh home); deadline: 480s, the default - the command is not a sweep naming suites, so there is no recorded cost to size it from

outcome.technical: Python extractor (scripts/lib/prescan/python.mjs): SQLModel table classes (table=True, __tablename__ literal else lowercased class name, fields of SQLModel bases first, Field(primary_key/foreign_key), Relationship and ClassVar skipped) become entities with framework sqlmodel; plain SQLModel classes are schemas (SQLModel is a Pydantic root); .sql files are read through the shared sqlStatements parser into sqlTables rows with ddl columns; foldMigrations replays Alembic upgrade ops (revision chain, then path: create_table, add_column, drop_column, drop_table) and emits an entity (framework alembic) for each table no model or CREATE TABLE declares; columnFacts now reads sa.Integer() as Integer. prescan.mjs needed no change, since entities and ddl sqlTables already become `tables` rows. Node-backend (node-backend.mjs): new Knex migration reader (createTable, createTableIfNotExists, alterTable add/dropColumn, increments/primary/references/inTable/foreign/timestamps; only the up part; computed names skipped and counted); a knex row is emitted only where no other ORM declares the table. merge.mjs: when meta.sources records introspection skipped and no introspection run ok (full build, not update), a field marked observed that no static source named is relabelled inferred, with one normalisation row; the union of declared fields into explorer entities was already in generateFromExtracts, so the merge test probes this new rule (m32 red before, m32b locks the controls: a run that is ok, or no skip record, relabels nothing). Docs: schema-introspection.md now says introspection adds observed fields to declared ones and never stands in for a missing database; stack-python-backend.md names what prescan declares. Fixture python-api gained shop/members.py (SQLModel), app/schema.sql, migrations/versions/0003_create_loans.py; py2-py5, py10, py12, py14 updated; python-api measure: app 5 + shop 2 table rows before, now app 6 (+fines), shop 3 (+members), migrations 1 (+loans) = 10. Full `node --test`: 503 pass, 0 fail (exit 0). I tried to put provenance 'declared' on the prescan table rows, but prescan-core pc11 requires summary rows to equal the full extract's first rows, so adding a key moved the explorer summary; I reverted prescan.mjs fully (git diff --stat empty for it) and merge marks every row's fields declared. Process notes: I edited scripts/prescan.mjs once through a Bash python one-liner, the plan-gate hook noticed it as uncovered, and I reverted and redid it with Edit before reverting it for good; the Bash heredoc that wrote fixture files was refused by the plan gate (its one free file was already spent on prescan.mjs) so I wrote them with the Write tool; I ran git add -N on the python-api fixture files (index only, no commit); shop/members.py is still untracked. Dependants: merge.mjs importers (pipeline.mjs, golden.test.mjs, merge.test.mjs) still correct, since the export surface is unchanged and the new rule only fires on a skipped introspection row with no ok row, and the golden/pipeline tests pass; docs/architecture/architecture.model.json and archmap.html unchanged, so still valid (committed-map validation tests pass); prescan.mjs (basename) unchanged; schema-introspection.md dependants (skill-discovery-refs test, explorer agent, design.md, SKILL.md, discovery-generic.md, stack-node-backend.md, stack-python-backend.md) still correct, no file name or section heading removed, only prose added, refs test passes; python-api fixture dependants (prescan-python, prescan-core, prescan-wiring tests, fixture README) still correct after the py2-py14 updates, README rows added, core and wiring tests pass unmodified; python.mjs dependants (stacks/python.mjs re-export, stack-python-backend.md, README) still correct, exports unchanged; node-backend.mjs dependants (stacks/node-backend.mjs, stack-node-backend.md, node-api README, tests) still correct, exports unchanged; tests/prescan-python and tests/prescan-node-backend: no dependants; tests/merge.test.mjs dependants (committed model, archmap.html, roadmap.md) only cite it, still correct. Not done: .sql files are read by the python plug-in only, so a node-only repo with a schema.sql gets no table rows from it; Alembic rename_table, alter_column types and batch_alter_table are not replayed.
outcome.descriptive: A repository without its database file now still maps its tables with declared fields from SQLAlchemy, SQLModel, Alembic-only, Knex and .sql/string DDL sources, and merge no longer lets an unbacked observed label stand when introspection was skipped.

testsAdded: py17: a tmp git repo with SQLAlchemy and SQLModel models, an Alembic create_table plus add_column, a CREATE TABLE string literal and a .sql file and no database file yields every table as a prescan table row with fields and evidence; py2-py10 extended on the python-api fixture
